description.value: Sweet Talk is a specialty donut and breakfast café in Port Moody serving pillowy soft artisan donuts with rotating daily flavours alongside breakfast sandwiches on brioche buns. The shop also operates a seasonal cocktail bar described as a cozy hideaway rooted in classics and inspired by the season. A compact, neighbourhood spot with a strong local following, it would make a sweet mid-ride stop on the Burrard Inlet corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: staple at 41m; staple at 98m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sweet Talk is a real, operating donut-and-coffee café at 87 Moody St, Port Moody BC, with an active menu of specialty donuts and breakfast sandwiches. A notable geographic discrepancy exists: OSM assigns this record to 'North Vancouver' community, while the website consistently states 'Port Moody BC' — Port Moody is the correct municipality. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those fields remain null; takeout is effectively confirmed by the counter-service donut and breakfast format.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the business is in Port Moody BC — these are distinct municipalities. The OSM record may be misassigned to the wrong community.
Address confirmed as Port Moody by website; OSM address field omits the city/municipality entirely, which may cause geocoding issues.
No phone number available in OSM or on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating café with an active website and confirmed address. A useful food and coffee stop for cyclists on the Port Moody waterfront corridor.

wow_evidence: specialty donut and breakfast café...strong local following
